description: Searched in Slovak and English for a standalone, browsable NBS register of fit-and-proper approvals / approved key function holders (e.g. 'zoznam udelených predchádzajúcich súhlasov', 'zoznam vedúcich zamestnancov'). No such dedicated register surfaced.

result.result_summary: Individual prior-consent approvals appear to be published only as operative parts of decisions inside the general 'výroky rozhodnutí' register and its PDF archives, not as a structured person-level dataset.

why_it_matters: The A5 pipeline cannot rely on a clean person-role table from NBS; it must NER-extract names and roles from decision text, which raises extraction cost and error rate.

description: A search-result snippet referenced a codelist endpoint under https://subjekty.nbs.sk/api/ for PSD2 institution-type codes, and the subjekty.nbs.sk page advertises 'Databáza na stiahnutie'. I did not independently confirm the endpoint shape or that a full entity export exists.

result.result_summary: Bulk/API access is plausible but unconfirmed in this pass.

why_it_matters: If a real API exists it removes the need for brittle scraping of the flagship pointer source; confirming it is the highest-leverage next engineering step.

description: Could not confirm from the fetched subjekty.nbs.sk content whether the supervised-entity records include statutory-body member names, or only entity identity and scope of authorisation.

result.result_summary: The fetch returned navigation/sector structure only; person-level fields were not visible.

why_it_matters: Determines whether NBS's register alone can answer 'who holds which seat', or whether ORSR/Obchodný vestník must carry that load.

description: The page requiring supervised entities to inform NBS about general meetings and sessions of the supervisory board and statutory body was found under the insurance (poistovníctvo) branch. A banking/payments equivalent was not located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Mechanism confirmed for insurance; unconfirmed for banks and payment institutions.

why_it_matters: If a banking analogue exists, it is a near-real-time governance-event channel; if not, the cell must fall back on decisions + commercial register.

description: English searches found ECB fit-and-proper methodology and aggregate sanctioning statistics, but no ECB publication naming individuals approved to Slovak bank boards.

result.result_summary: ECB fit-and-proper outcomes for Slovak significant institutions appear not to be published at person level.

why_it_matters: For ECB-supervised Slovak banks, the regulator gatekeeper thesis holds legally but yields no public name-level record; NBS decisions, ORSR and Obchodný vestník become the operative sources.

description: ORSR's own public search does not support full-text search by predmet podnikania or by SK NACE code. Fetching https://www.orsr.sk/search_subjekt.asp showed the available criteria to be: obchodné meno, právna forma, registrový súd, and — via separate pages — IČO, sídlo, spisová značka, and priezvisko/meno osoby. There is no activity-code filter.

result.result_summary: The cell hypothesis that ORSR itself can enumerate the SK financial/payments population by NACE is not supported; that capability sits in the ŠÚ SR RPO register/API instead, which carries SK NACE.

why_it_matters: Population enumeration must be built as RPO(SK NACE) -> IČO list -> ORSR per-entity monitoring, or via the NBS supervised-entity lists, not by querying ORSR directly. Designing the collector the other way round would silently miss most actors.

description: No official ORSR-side push feed (RSS/webhook/'recently changed entries' listing) for statutory-body changes was found in either Slovak or English searching.

result.result_summary: Change detection appears to require either periodic diffing of per-entity extracts, ingestion of the Obchodný vestník, or a commercial aggregator (FinStat) / civic aggregator (Slovensko.Digital) that does the diffing.

why_it_matters: Collection cost and latency for this cell are driven by polling design; budget for diff-based monitoring rather than assuming a subscribe-able feed. Unverified whether the new sluzby.orsr.sk portal exposes such an endpoint.

description: Re-use and rate-limit terms were not verified first-hand for orsr.sk, registeruz.sk and obchodnyvestnik.justice.gov.sk (no robots.txt or ToS fetched in this pass). Slovensko.Digital's rate limit and FinStat's paid tiers are known only from their own marketing/service pages.

result.result_summary: Access/legal_status values for the state portals are stated from statutory context, not from a fetched policy document.

why_it_matters: Before production scraping, robots.txt and terms for each state portal should be read, and the Slovensko.Digital podmienky-sluzieb reviewed, to avoid building a collector on unverified permission.

description: No dedicated Slovak register-side vocabulary exists for 'hiring' or 'jobs' below board level — registers record only štatutárny orgán, prokúra, dozorná rada, vedúci organizačnej zložky and (via RÚZ annual reports) priemerný počet zamestnancov.

result.result_summary: This cell can evidence leadership moves and headcount aggregates, but not recruitment or mid-level hiring.

why_it_matters: Jobs/hiring topics in this run must be carried by other A5 cells (job boards, LinkedIn-type sources, press); registers should not be over-claimed as a hiring signal.

description: Klub 500 (owners of companies with 500+ employees) does not publish a member list; reporting indicates members prefer not to be named publicly.

result.result_summary: Searched sk-language for 'Klub 500 členovia zoznam'; found only the organisation profile, LinkedIn page and commentary, no roster.

why_it_matters: Klub 500 was named in the cell scope as a directory candidate; it is a lobbying voice but NOT usable as an actor directory. Track its statements, not its membership.

description: AmCham Slovakia's published committee list (15 committees/working groups) does not include a dedicated Financial Services committee.

result.result_summary: Committee names found: Civil Code Task Force, Business-Academic Cooperation, Digital, Employment and Social Affairs, Energy, Health Care, Public Procurement Task Force, Rule of Law Initiative, Tax. No financial-services committee surfaced.

why_it_matters: The seed query assumed such a committee exists; A5 should instead use the Digital and Employment & Social Affairs committees plus the board (which includes Citibank) as the finance-relevant entry points.

description: No dedicated Slovak 'asociácia platobných inštitúcií' (association of payment institutions) was found as a distinct body.

result.result_summary: sk-language searches returned the Slovenská FinTech asociácia, SBA and insurance/intermediary bodies instead. The payment-institution segment appears represented via the FinTech association and SBA's payments commissions rather than a standalone association.

why_it_matters: Prevents chasing a non-existent directory; the NBS register of payment institutions (a different cell) plus slovakfintech.sk/clenovia are the substitute enumeration.

description: SBA's ~14 expert commissions are described in aggregate (200+ professionals) but individual commission member rosters are not published on the public site.

result.result_summary: Both the sk seed query on pracovné skupiny and a fetch of /o-nas/ returned commission names only, no named members.

why_it_matters: The richest named-officeholder layer in this cell is not directly harvestable; must be reconstructed indirectly from standards documents, SEPA implementation plans, and conference agendas.

description: The most detailed AOCP and ITAS leadership rosters found via search are from earlier terms, not confirmed current.

result.result_summary: AOCP výbor names (Blaho, Franek, Kopál, Laluha, Prekop, Vrzgula, Zelina) and ITAS 2017 board (Fitoš, Lelovský, Chamraz et al.) come from dated announcements.

why_it_matters: Do not treat these as current officeholders; the value is the pattern (announcement page type recurs each term), not the specific names.

description: No dedicated 'Kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie' (SBA banking congress) event page, programme or speaker roster could be located.

result.result_summary: Searching 'kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie program recnici' in Slovak returned only the SBA corporate site, its Wikipedia entry, SBA Educa (exam body) and directory listings — no congress page. SBA may not run a public named congress, or it is announced only via LinkedIn/members-only channels.

why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes a flagship SBA congress as a primary org-chart snapshot; if it does not exist publicly, Finweek and ZBK events must carry that role.

description: No Slovakia-hosted 'Banking Summit' was found; the term maps to foreign events.

result.result_summary: Bilingual search for 'banking summit' / 'bankovy summit' Slovensko 2026 returned only Future Banking Summit (Brasov, RO, 7-9 Oct 2026), European Banking Summit (28 Jan 2026), FT Global Banking Summit and vendor listicles. No SK-hosted equivalent surfaced.

why_it_matters: 'Banking Summit' is a noisy term for SK scouting; regional CEE summits (Brasov) should instead be mined for Slovak speakers rather than treated as SK sources.

description: No CEE/Central-Europe edition of the ICCOS cash-cycle seminar exists for 2026.

result.result_summary: Only EMEA (Cape Town, 30 Nov - 2 Dec 2026) and Americas editions are scheduled; ATMIA covers Europe via a Berlin/Madrid roadshow. No CEE-specific cash/ATM conference with a published SK speaker roster was found.

why_it_matters: Cash-cycle and ATM function holders in SK banks have no regional conference stage, so this function will stay under-observed by the events channel and needs a different source (tenders, vendor case studies).

description: ZBK events page publishes no speaker names on the listing page.

result.result_summary: Fetch of zbk.sk/podujatia returned five 2026 events with title/date/venue (Crowne Plaza Bratislava) but no lecturers, titles or agendas at listing level. Speaker data, if published, sits on per-event detail pages or PDF programmes not reachable from the listing excerpt.

why_it_matters: Collection design must follow event detail pages and PDFs, not just the calendar, or the highest-value cards/payments name-title data will be missed.

description: No university career-fair exhibitor list for EUBA or STU Bratislava could be located.

result.result_summary: Slovak search for 'Den kariery Ekonomicka univerzita Bratislava STU vystavovatelia banky 2026' returned only university profile pages, catalogues and Wikipedia — no career-day page with an exhibitor roster. Such pages likely exist on faculty subdomains or Facebook events not indexed by the search engine used.

why_it_matters: University fairs are the cell's stated signal for graduate-pipeline expansion by banks; without exhibitor lists this sub-channel is currently unsourced.

description: The two richest people-level event sources are gated.

result.result_summary: LinkedIn (association pages, event attendee/speaker lists) is auth-walled with anti-scraping ToS; The Banker's Bank of the Year coverage is subscription-only. Both were reachable only through open mirrors (bank press releases, TASR/OTS).

why_it_matters: Automated collection must route around them via press-release mirrors and manual analyst review, or title data will be incomplete and legally risky to gather.

description: The ÚVO root domain https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ surfaced in search results with an 'Error' page title, and section URLs were reachable only indirectly via search snippets during this pass.

result.result_summary: Recorded as unverified, not dead. ÚVO is a statutory portal and is near-certainly live; the symptom is consistent with bot-defence, transient outage or a redirect. Liveness must be settled by the deterministic verification pass, and an open-data / TED fallback route is already listed.

why_it_matters: Declaring the primary SK procurement portal dead on one bad signal would break the whole public-portal route for this cell.

description: Searched for a central SK registry of political/board nominations to state-owned enterprises (the 'nominacie.gov.sk' hypothesis) that would consolidate appointments to SZRB, Eximbanka and similar.

result.result_summary: No such consolidated nominations register was found. Civil-service vacancies are centralised at cisss.gov.sk, but board appointments to state-owned banks are decided by the vláda SR and surface only in government session records, MF SR press releases, the institutions' own pages and news wires.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move tracking for state-linked banks cannot be single-sourced; it needs a multi-source watch (institution page + MF SR + wire) rather than one register poll.

description: Searched in Slovak for a current contractual/ownership nexus between Slovenská pošta and Poštová banka covering cash operations at post-office counters.

result.result_summary: Found Poštová banka's own cash-operations product page and Slovenská pošta's procurement profile, plus a CRZ listing for Slovenská pošta, but no specific published contract between the two was located in this pass.

why_it_matters: The post-office cash network is a major SK payments channel; the contractual arrangement must be located in CRZ full text rather than assumed, and remains an open collection task.

description: TED could not be queried with a live SK+CPV filter through generic web search; only TED's own help, CPV and sector-browse pages were retrievable.

result.result_summary: No actual SK payment-services notice was retrieved in this pass. The TED entry is recorded as a high-confidence structural source (official API/bulk data documented), not as a set of verified individual notices.

why_it_matters: The candidate must be operationalised with real API queries before anyone assumes SK payment-services notices exist in volume on TED.

description: Leadership facts retrieved via search snippets carry uncertain dates (e.g. an SZRB board-change item that appears to date from 2012; Eximbanka items spanning 2022-2023).

result.result_summary: No leadership roster is recorded here as current. Only the source pages are recorded; the roster itself must be read fresh from the institution's own page at collection time.

why_it_matters: A5 conclusions built on undated snippet-level leadership claims would be wrong; this is precisely why the primary governance pages are ranked above the news wires.

description: No Accenture Slovensko-specific announcement of a financial-services lead or SK FS practice leadership change was surfaced by either sk- or en-language searching.

result.result_summary: Searches for 'Accenture Slovensko novy riaditel financial services' returned only PwC/other results; no Accenture SK newsroom item located.

why_it_matters: Accenture is a named cell actor; without a locatable SK newsroom, its FS leadership moves may only be observable via LinkedIn or third-party media, which changes the collection method.

description: No Finastra press release or reference page naming a Slovak bank customer was found.

result.result_summary: Temenos/Finastra + Slovakia searches produced only a partner-licensing item (Orion Innovation) and generic vendor pages; no SK-named Finastra deployment.

why_it_matters: Leaves a gap in mapping which global core/payments vendors actually serve SK systemic banks; supplier-side visibility for Finastra in SK appears near-zero.

description: Slovak banks deliberately do not name their IT suppliers, as noted in SK trade coverage curated by Asseco itself.

result.result_summary: A clipping titled to the effect that banks do not boast about their IT suppliers and present digital innovation as their own work; several vendor references are anonymised ('a financial institution').

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale and means client attribution must often be inferred from job ads, LinkedIn and anonymised case-study detail rather than stated client names.

description: No dedicated 'banking delivery centre' designation or banking-specific headcount breakdown was found for Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia.

result.result_summary: Company pages give total headcount (>3,900) and a general ICT-outsourcing mission for DT Group clients, not a banking vertical figure.

why_it_matters: Supplier headcount for this actor cannot be attributed to bank spend; it is a labour-market benchmark only, not a bank-programme signal.

description: No SK-specific IBM Slovensko or DXC Technology Slovakia customer/reference page for banking was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only directory and country-profile mentions; no vendor-hosted SK banking reference pages surfaced.

why_it_matters: Two named cell actors remain unmapped; their SK bank footprint may only be visible via job ads or global case studies filtered by country.

description: No public, per-employer register of collective-redundancy notifications (hromadné prepúšťanie) filed with ÚPSVaR was found. Searches surfaced only procedural guidance and aggregate counts; the notification itself contains employee names/addresses and is evidently not published.

result.result_summary: Aggregate statistics and press releases exist; a named, case-level feed does not appear to be public.

why_it_matters: The single most valuable A5 signal (which bank, how many, when) is likely obtainable only via aggregate data plus press/union corroboration, or via an infozákon (211/2000) freedom-of-information request to ÚPSVaR.

description: No European Works Council or zamestnanecká rada page was found for the Slovak subsidiaries of Erste (Slovenská sporiteľňa) or Intesa Sanpaolo (VÚB). Searches in both sk and en returned only ownership/corporate background.

result.result_summary: Works-council-level disclosure for SK banks appears absent from the open web.

why_it_matters: EWC consultation documents often describe cross-border reorganisations first; without them the workforce channel depends on national unions and press.

description: No company-level collective agreement (podniková kolektívna zmluva) text for any Slovak bank was located publicly; only the higher-level (KZVS) deposit register is public, and banking currently has no sector agreement because SBA refuses sector bargaining.

result.result_summary: Bank-level CBA texts not publicly posted.

why_it_matters: Redundancy severance multiples and consultation terms — the concrete cost of restructuring — stay invisible; must be inferred from union statements.

description: Obchodný vestník, Register úpadcov (JSF/xhtml) and NR SR document viewer are ASPX/JSF applications with parameterised URLs; their machine-accessibility (stable IDs, bulk export, robots policy) was not tested in this pass.

result.result_summary: URLs recorded; liveness and scrapability left to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: These are the backbone automation targets for this cell; if they resist crawling, budget for browser automation.

description: Targeted Slovak-language searches for a banking or payments shared-service/GBS centre in Žilina or Banská Bystrica returned no sector-specific hits; results were generic municipal-employment and job-portal pages.

result.result_summary: Query 'Žilina Banská Bystrica centrum zdieľaných služieb banka poisťovňa nové pracovné miesta 2025' produced no relevant financial-sector centre announcements.

why_it_matters: Either these cities host no significant banking/payments nearshore delivery footprint, or such presence is announced only through channels not reachable by generic search (employer career sites, local print press). Coverage for the western/central regional cities is therefore thin and should not be read as absence.

description: No evidence found of a Worldline, Global Payments, Mastercard or Visa delivery/operations centre located in Košice, Nitra or Prešov.

result.result_summary: Payments-scheme and acquirer searches surfaced only global corporate and careers pages, no Slovak regional-city site.

why_it_matters: The payments half of the sector may be Bratislava-concentrated in Slovakia, with the regional nearshore footprint dominated by IT/finance captives of banks and telcos instead. Needs confirmation against company registry data rather than search.

description: No concrete bank–university partnership or bank-sponsored graduate programme in eastern/central Slovakia was located via search, in either language.

result.result_summary: TUKE searches confirmed a Finance/Banking/Investment study programme but surfaced no named bank partnership, scholarship or trainee scheme.

why_it_matters: The university-industry angle of the cell is currently evidenced only structurally (via Košice IT Valley membership), not by specific programmes; requires direct fetching of faculty partner pages and career-fair exhibitor lists rather than search engines.

description: The only banking-specific Košice expansion article surfaced (HSBC expands to Košice, The Slovak Spectator) is roughly a decade and a half old.

result.result_summary: Search returned the item but its vintage makes it unusable as current intelligence.

why_it_matters: Search-engine ranking favours old, well-linked articles for this cell; collection must be recency-filtered and driven by feeds rather than ad-hoc search.

description: Tatra banka's press-release index at https://www.tatrabanka.sk/sk/blog/tlacove-spravy/ returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain server-side fetch, while individual article slugs on the same path are indexed and reachable via search.

result.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead. Requires a browser-like fetch (real UA, JS-capable client) or an RSS/sitemap route.

why_it_matters: Tatra banka is one of the three systemic SK banks; losing its self-published leadership channel would leave a hole that only third-party wires could partially fill.

description: No standalone Slovak-language press centre was located on mbank.sk itself; the SK press function appears to live on the group subdomain sk.media.mbank.pl. Likewise no distinct SK press/'o nás – vedenie' subpath was confirmed for oberbank.sk within this pass.

result.result_summary: mBank SK press room identified on a foreign-group host; Oberbank SK press/management subpath unresolved (only the site root confirmed).

why_it_matters: Branch-form banks (pobočka zahraničnej banky) often have no SK-level governance page at all, so SK branch leadership must be inferred from group announcements plus the SK company register — a systematically weaker signal for the smaller players in the cell.

description: Slovak-language searches for Prima banka press releases on predstavenstvo/dozorná rada changes returned almost only annual-report PDFs and third-party portals, not a press-release index on primabanka.sk.

result.result_summary: No press-release feed confirmed for Prima banka; the manazment-banky page plus annual reports plus orsr.sk are the practical channel.

why_it_matters: For this actor, page-diffing and register-diffing must substitute for press monitoring, which changes the collection design and the achievable detection latency (months, not days).

description: Prima banka annual reports are served from /preview-file/<slug>-<numeric-id>.pdf paths where the numeric id appears to be a rotating internal document id.

result.result_summary: Hard-coded PDF URLs are likely to break between years.

why_it_matters: A collector that pins these URLs will silently start failing; the link must be re-resolved from the site each cycle.

description: FinStat.sk, the most convenient aggregator of SK register + financial + headcount data, is a commercial service with paywalled tiers.

result.result_summary: Recorded with collection_allowed=false; usable as a manual entity-resolution pointer or under a paid API licence only.

why_it_matters: Avoids building a pipeline on a source whose ToS would not survive review, when orsr.sk provides the same statutory facts for free.

description: No dedicated Erste Group 'Capital Markets Day' event page or deck focused on a Slovakia segment restructuring or a Bratislava hub relocation was found in this pass.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only regular quarterly results presentations and earnings calls in which Slovakia is discussed as one of seven core markets; no CMD-specific Slovak restructuring material surfaced.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes CMD decks are a leading indicator; for Erste the practical substitute is the quarterly results deck plus the annual report segment chapter, so collection design should not depend on a CMD cadence.

description: No Intesa Sanpaolo price-sensitive release specifically announcing a current VUB Banka management change was located.

result.result_summary: The IR press-release archive surfaced results releases and historical Slovak items (2002 IntesaBci-in-VUB anniversary, 2004 pension JV) plus a newsroom CEO interview, but no recent VUB board-change ad-hoc.

why_it_matters: Suggests Intesa treats VUB executive appointments as non-price-sensitive and routes them to the newsroom or to VUB itself, so the Slovak-language cell may lead the English parent cell for this owner — the opposite of the cell's default assumption.

description: There is no Slovak-domiciled UniCredit issuer with its own IR channel.

result.result_summary: UniCredit's Slovak business has operated since Dec 2013 as a foreign-bank branch (pobocka zahranicnej banky) of UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, so disclosure sits at unicreditbank.cz and unicreditgroup.eu.

why_it_matters: Any collector keyed to a Slovak UniCredit IR domain will find nothing; the branch structure must be encoded in the actor map or UniCredit SK leadership changes will be missed entirely.

description: OTP has no Slovak banking subsidiary.

result.result_summary: OTP Banka Slovensko was sold to KBC (agreed 17 Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020) and merged into CSOB; OTP Group IR is therefore historical for SK.

why_it_matters: The seed actor list includes OTP; keeping it at normal priority would waste collection budget. Demote to low-frequency watch.

description: No PPF Group ownership link to a Slovak bank or licensed payment institution was confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: Searching the parent-owner set surfaced J&T Finance Group as the relevant Czech-domiciled owner (365.bank, J&T Banka SK branch); PPF did not appear as an owner of an SK bank in any result reviewed.

why_it_matters: PPF appears in the cell brief paired with J&T; treating them as equivalent would create a phantom actor. PPF should be re-tested specifically against payments/consumer-finance entities rather than banks before being kept or dropped.

description: Slovak-language search returns almost no parent-group ad-hoc material.

result.result_summary: The sk query using 'ad hoc oznamenie / materska skupina / zmena predstavenstva / generalny riaditel' returned Slovak media and subsidiary newsrooms (slsp.sk, vub.sk, banky.sk, startitup.sk), not parent-group regulated disclosure.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's English-first design is correct and that it does not overlap the sk newsroom cell; but it also means sk terms are useful only for entity-name joins, not for finding parent disclosure.

description: The OeKB Issuer Information Center was not fetched in this pass.

result.result_summary: Its role as Austria's OAM feeding the Wiener Boerse ad-hoc page was established indirectly from search results; the portal itself and its search/export interface were not exercised.

why_it_matters: It is likely the highest-integrity archive for Erste/RBI regulated news; access mechanics (search UI vs. API, rate limits) must be tested before it can be designed into a collector.

description: No dedicated Slovak-language trade outlet or newsletter covering the payments-processing/acquiring industry as an industry (people moves, hub news) was found; SK payments coverage is scattered across general finance media (Finsider, Trend, HN) and PR wires.

result.result_summary: Searches for SK payments-sector trade press returned only consumer-facing card/bank stories and job boards.

why_it_matters: There is no single high-yield SK feed for A5-type events; collection must be assembled from registers plus employer sites plus general media, raising cost and latency.

description: No SK-specific corporate presence or Slovak legal entity for NCR Atleos surfaced in search; only the US-listed parent appeared. Its SK footprint (if any) may sit under a Czech or Hungarian entity, or under an outsourced service partner.

result.result_summary: Query pairing Diebold Nixdorf with NCR Atleos in Bratislava returned Diebold Nixdorf s.r.o. records only.

why_it_matters: One named actor in the cell may have no direct SK employer footprint; ATM-estate signals for NCR may have to be tracked via bank tenders and service partners instead.

description: No Visa or Mastercard country-manager-for-Slovakia appointment announcement was found in either sk or en searching; scheme coverage appears to be run from a Prague/CEE cluster with SK folded into CZ&SK roles.

result.result_summary: Slovak query 'Visa Mastercard country manager Slovensko vymenovanie' returned card-portfolio news and a Prague-based CZ&SK Mastercard vacancy, no appointment news.

why_it_matters: The cell's assumption of discrete SK country managers at the schemes may be partly wrong; monitoring should target CZ/CEE cluster announcements and Workday postings rather than SK-only news.

description: No Wirecard-successor entity with a live Slovak operation was identified in this pass; no SK-language term for such successors surfaced beyond generic 'platobná inštitúcia'.

result.result_summary: Not evidenced in searches performed; the actor was not pursued to exhaustion.

why_it_matters: A named actor group in the cell brief may be irrelevant to SK, or requires a different entity-name entry point (e.g. via NBS PSD2 register diffing rather than by brand name).

description: It is unconfirmed whether ÚPSVaR proactively publishes a list of received mass-layoff notifications, or whether such lists are obtainable only by FOI request.

result.result_summary: The ÚPSVaR page describes employer obligations but no public notification register was located.

why_it_matters: The highest-value layoff early-warning channel may be FOI-gated, which changes collection design (periodic infožiadosť rather than scraping).

description: LinkedIn — the richest source for country-manager and hub-lead moves — is auth-walled and its ToS prohibits automated collection.

result.result_summary: Company pages surfaced in search but content is login-gated.

why_it_matters: A core A5 signal channel cannot be automated; budget for manual analyst review or a licensed people-data provider.

description: No Slovak equivalent of a 'people moves' / appointments column was found for the fintech small-cap segment. Searches in sk for leadership changes at named actors (Fumbi, Finax, TrustPay/finby) returned company profile pages and review articles, not personnel news.

result.result_summary: Leadership-move intelligence for this cell has no single editorial home; it must be assembled from register diffs (ORSR/FinStat), company team-page diffs, and founder LinkedIn posts.

why_it_matters: The collection design cannot rely on a media feed for the cell's core topic; the register + team-page diffing tier is load-bearing, not supplementary.

description: Instarea returned no results in either the en or sk searches run in this pass; its current status, fintech relevance and any funding/hiring activity are unconfirmed. Similarly, no Slovak BNPL player (including any Nay-linked offering) was confirmed by name.

result.result_summary: Two seed actors named in the cell definition could not be substantiated from search in this pass.

why_it_matters: The seed actor list may contain stale or mis-specified entries; carrying them forward unverified would pollute the watchlist.

description: TrustPay, a headline seed actor, appears to have rebranded to 'finby' and taken a Malta licence for EU expansion, per a SK commentary piece and the company's own press-release page.

result.result_summary: The seed actor name is stale; both names (and the SK and CZ legal entities) must be aliased in the glossary.

why_it_matters: Name-based monitoring keyed only on 'TrustPay' would silently miss all post-rebrand announcements — precisely the period when a licence-driven org build-out occurs.

description: No SK-specific startup job board was confirmed. The query assumed 'startupjobs.sk' exists (the known regional board is the CZ-origin startupjobs.cz); results returned only Profesia and praca.sme.sk.

result.result_summary: Startup-specific job inventory for SK appears to sit on general boards and company career pages rather than a dedicated SK startup board.

why_it_matters: Hiring-signal collection must lean on general boards plus per-company career pages, which raises noise and per-actor crawl cost.

description: Several role titles this cell keys on have no settled Slovak form and circulate as English-in-local usage: 'Head of Compliance', 'Compliance Officer', 'CTO', 'MLRO'. The one live SK ad found blends both ('Staň sa naším hlavným Compliance Officerom').

result.result_summary: sk-language keyword sets must include untranslated English role titles inside Slovak sentences, plus 'zodpovedná osoba' as the AML-officer term of art.

why_it_matters: A purely translated sk keyword list would miss most real postings; a purely English one would miss the Slovak sentence context that identifies the employer as SK-domiciled.

description: 'FINTECH SK' appears to be an actual company name (an MiCA-regulated SK fintech advertising a lead compliance officer role), which collides with the generic phrase 'fintech SK' used in most queries.

result.result_summary: Query and dedupe logic must disambiguate the company name from the generic sector-plus-country phrase.

why_it_matters: Unhandled, this collision either buries a real watchlist actor or floods the pipeline with generic sector articles.

description: No confirmation that major SK banks expose standard third-party ATS endpoints (Workday myworkdayjobs.com, SmartRecruiters jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>, SuccessFactors career sites) for Slovak entities.

result.result_summary: Searches in en surfaced only generic SmartRecruiters/Indeed landing pages; observed SK bank ATS are local (topjobs.sk, kariera.tatrabanka.sk, vub.sk, csob.jobs.cz/LMC).

why_it_matters: Machine-readable ATS JSON endpoints would enable cheap structured collection; their apparent absence means collection must target HTML career pages and boards instead.

description: Praca.sk and Robota.sk were probed as SK job boards but did not surface as live, distinct portals in results.

result.result_summary: Queries returned Profesia, Kariera.sk (Zoznam), Worki.sk and the government portal instead; no evidence retrieved for praca.sk/robota.sk current status.

why_it_matters: Two seed-named boards may be defunct or merged (SK board market consolidated under Alma Career/Profesia); the collection plan should not assume they exist without verification.

description: No SK-language recruiting presence found for Worldline, Nexi, or card-scheme offices (Visa/Mastercard) in Slovakia during this pass.

result.result_summary: sk query mixing 'platobné', 'nábor' and vendor names returned only Global Payments (CZ/SK) and generic pages.

why_it_matters: Payments-vendor hiring is a leading indicator of terminal/acquiring programmes; the absence of a SK-language channel means these must be tracked via English group ATS or CZ boards.

description: LinkedIn jobs pages for SK banks are login-gated and ToS-restricted.

result.result_summary: Only public teaser pages appear in search; no automated collection attempted.

why_it_matters: The richest source for leadership moves and senior hiring cannot be collected programmatically; budget for manual analyst review or licensed data.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed reachable; all entries come from search-result evidence only.

result.result_summary: Liveness, HTTP status, and robots/ToS posture are unverified by design.

why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must confirm status codes and anti-bot posture before any collection is scheduled.

description: Public web search cannot reliably retrieve individual LinkedIn *posts* by Slovak banking/payments professionals. Queries combining SK move phrases ('po rokoch opúšťam', 'nová výzva') with bank terms returned profile and company pages, never the underlying activity posts.

result.result_summary: Zero SK-language personal announcement posts retrieved via search engine; only profile/company URLs surfaced.

why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — the individual announces before the employer — is real, but the post layer is effectively invisible to search-engine-based collection. Any production pipeline for this cell needs logged-in monitoring, LinkedIn's own APIs, or a licensed data product; a search-only pipeline will systematically miss the earliest signal.

description: No public, retrievable time series of LinkedIn employee-count for SK banks was found. Wikipedia and RocketReach give single-point headcounts (SLSP ~3,540 in 2023; Tatra banka ~3,500; 365.bank 616 in 2024) but no curve.

result.result_summary: Point-in-time headcounts only; no trend data source identified.

why_it_matters: The 'headcount curve as org-change proxy' idea requires self-built snapshotting over time, or a paid product (LinkedIn Talent Insights, Live Data Technologies). Budget for it or drop the indicator.

description: Dedicated Slovak LinkedIn company pages for VÚB (Všeobecná úverová banka), UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, mBank SK, Privatbanka, Prima banka and Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka were not confirmed by URL in this run, although the institutions are clearly present and Wikipedia/thebanks.eu profiles were found.

result.result_summary: Institution confirmed, LinkedIn page URL not confirmed.

why_it_matters: These are major employers; leaving their pages unmapped is a real coverage hole in the professional-social channel. Should be resolved by direct LinkedIn company-name lookup rather than search engine.

description: No specific named Slovak banking/fintech recruiter or headhunter personal LinkedIn profile was identified in this run — only firm-level pages (Pedersen & Partners, Amrop, KPMG, KiTalent) and a listicle naming Pro HR and PERSONALITY.

result.result_summary: Firm level yes, person level no.

why_it_matters: The recruiter-posts-first hypothesis needs named individual feeds to be actionable; firm pages post far less and far later.

description: Slovak query terms 'platby'/'platobné' and 'banka' collide heavily with LinkedIn's own help pages about paying for Premium via a bank, and with unrelated consumer content; 'nová výzva' is generic motivational language across all sectors.

result.result_summary: High false-positive rate on the most obvious SK query terms.

why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must anchor on institution names plus role nouns ('riaditeľ', 'člen predstavenstva', 'vedúci oddelenia platobných služieb') rather than on the move-phrase alone.

description: No dedicated Stanton Chase office in Bratislava/Slovakia surfaced in either sk or en searches; nearest listed CEE offices are Prague, Vienna and Belgrade.

result.result_summary: Slovak mandates appear to be served regionally; no SK-specific Stanton Chase publication channel identified.

why_it_matters: Avoids creating a phantom SK source; SK signals from Stanton Chase must be filtered out of regional/global content.

description: No standalone Hays Slovakia salary guide (hays.sk) was found; Slovak coverage appears folded into the Hays Czech Republic mzdový průzkum and CEE business-services teams.

result.result_summary: Only hays.cz salary-guide assets and a Hays Slovakia employer page on profesia.sk were located.

why_it_matters: SK banking pay benchmarks from Hays must be sourced from a CZ-branded, registration-gated publication, with caution about country mix.

description: Searching in Slovak for explicit placement announcements ('obsadenie pozície', 'úspešne obsadená pozícia') by SK search firms returned no systematic announcement feed — SK executive search firms rarely publish named placements.

result.result_summary: Firms publish rankings, sector pages and thought leadership instead of named placements.

why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection in SK must lean on media, LinkedIn and company press rooms rather than search-firm announcements.

description: Searches did not surface an active Iventa Slovakia presence or SK-language content for Iventa within this cell's queries.

result.result_summary: Iventa appears mainly as an AT/CEE brand in results; no SK banking-relevant publication found.

why_it_matters: The seed actor list should be corrected rather than assumed live in SK.

description: Direct WebFetch of https://www.trend.sk/ and https://hnonline.sk/ both failed with a generic 'unable to fetch' from this agent's tooling; no HTTP status observed.

result.result_summary: Section maps, rubric URLs and RSS endpoints for the two most important Slovak business outlets could not be enumerated. Both are almost certainly live (they appear constantly in search results and third-party traffic profiles) — this is a tooling/bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence of a dead site.

why_it_matters: TREND and HN are the cell's two anchor outlets; without their section/RSS structure the collector will fall back to search-engine discovery, which loses paywalled and older items.

description: Searched in Slovak for an explicit standing 'personalie' / 'ludia a kariery' column on trend.sk, hnonline.sk and forbes.sk.

result.result_summary: Only Pravda's ekonomika section (ekonomika.pravda.sk/ludia/) and SITA's tag archive (sita.sk/tag/personalne-zmeny/) were confirmed as dedicated people/appointment channels. Whether TREND, HN and Forbes.sk still run a discrete named personnel rubric could not be confirmed from search results alone.

why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes dedicated personnel columns across the domestic press; the evidence supports that only for a subset, so collection must lean on tag archives and keyword filters rather than named rubrics.

description: Looked for a free, complete TASR and SITA archive that could be crawled for dated appointment texts.

result.result_summary: TASR content is publicly visible only through its consumer portal teraz.sk, and SITA through sita.sk verticals/tags; the full wire products appear to be commercial subscriptions. No open bulk archive or public API was found.

why_it_matters: Dated, quotable primary text is the main value of the wires; without a licensed feed the collector gets only what the portals choose to publish, with unknown coverage gaps.

description: Assessed access for SME/Index, Denník N / Denník E, HN and TREND.

result.result_summary: All four operate subscription paywalls on the majority of substantive articles; headlines, ledes and tag listings remain open.

why_it_matters: The most detailed Slovak reporting on bank restructurings and contested exits is precisely the paywalled part. Budgeting for subscriptions is a prerequisite for anything beyond headline-level A5 monitoring.
